lead.question: 这个国家上一次举办奥运会是在什么时候？课文给出的答案是什么？
lead.warmup: 奥运会四年后首次在这个国家举行，这不只是体育盛事，更是一场全国总动员：政府要建新饭店、一个大型体育场和一个奥运会标准游泳池，还要修新路和铁路专线，首都市郊将被划作“奥林匹克城”。阅读时请留意三种将来时态的分工，以及被动语态怎样让叙述聚焦在事物本身。
goals: 区分并运用一般将来时被动、将来进行时与将来完成时
掌握 by the end of、in four years' time、look forward to、go up 等本课核心搭配
理解 hold（举行/容纳）、design、immense、standard、fantastic 的用法
能用将来时态与被动语态连贯描述一项大型工程的筹备与进度
lead.summary: 四年后奥运会首次在这个国家举行：政府将建饭店、大型体育场、奥运会标准游泳池、新路和铁路专线，赛场设在首都市郊，整片区域将被称为“奥林匹克城”。工程以将来完成时排期：今年年底铺好新路，明年年底建成新体育场；奇妙的现代化建筑由库尔特·冈特设计。
lead.tips: by the end of + 将来时间点，谓语用将来完成时 will have done；look forward to 的 to 是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。

questions.q: When was the last time this country hosted the Olympic Games?
questions.zh: 这个国家上一次举办奥林匹克运动会是在什么时候？
questions.a: Never. The Games have never been held before in this country, so this will be the first time.
questions.aZh: 从来没有举办过——这将是该国第一次举办奥运会。

questions.q: Where will the Games be held and what will the whole area be called?
questions.zh: 奥运会将在哪里举行？整片区域将被称作什么？
questions.a: The Games will be held just outside the capital and the whole area will be called 'Olympic City'.
questions.aZh: 奥运会就在首都市郊举行，整个地区将被称作“奥林匹克城”。
questions.hint: 出自 The Games will be held just outside the capital... 一句。

questions.q: What will the government be building for the great many visitors?
questions.zh: 政府将为大批来访者建造哪些设施？
questions.a: New hotels, an immense stadium, a new Olympic-standard swimming pool, new roads and a special railway line.
questions.aZh: 新饭店、大型体育场、奥运会标准游泳池，还有新道路和一条铁路专线。
questions.hint: 出自 As a great many people will be visiting the country 引导的第 2、3 句。

questions.q: What will have been completed by the end of this year, and what by the end of next year?
questions.zh: 到今年年底和明年年底，分别会完成什么工程？
questions.a: Workers will have completed the new roads by the end of this year, and by the end of next year they will have finished work on the new stadium.
questions.aZh: 今年年底前新路全部铺好；到明年年底新体育场完工。
questions.hint: 抓住两个 by the end of 时间状语。

questions.q: Why does the writer say 'will be building' instead of 'will build', and 'will have completed' instead of 'will complete'?
questions.zh: 为什么作者用 will be building 而不用 will build，用 will have completed 而不用 will complete？
questions.a: will be building 强调那段时间正在进行的动作，且是政府已规划好的安排；will have completed 强调在“今年年底”之前已经完成。两种时态分别回答“届时正在做什么”和“到某时已做完什么”。
questions.aZh: will be building 强调将来某时正在进行、也是已规划好的安排；will have completed 强调截止某时已经完成。
questions.hint: 结合课文语法：将来进行时表计划与正在进行，将来完成时表截止某时完成。

exercises.q: 用所给词的适当形式填空：The Olympic Games will be ____ (hold) in our country in four years' time.
exercises.note: 一般将来时被动：will be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: 填空：Workers will have ____ (complete) the new roads by the end of this year.
exercises.note: by the end of 用将来完成时。

exercises.q: 填空：By the end of next year, the workers ____ (work) on the new stadium for over a year.
填空：The fantastic modern buildings have been ____ (design) by Kurt Gunter.
填空：We are all very excited and are looking forward ____ the Olympic Games.
exercises.note: look forward to 中 to 是介词。

exercises.q: 选词填空（government / immense / standard）：the ________ will be building new hotels, an ________ stadium and a new Olympic-________ swimming pool.
汉译英：奥运会将在首都市郊举行，整个地区将被称作“奥林匹克城”。
exercises.a: The Games will be held just outside the capital and the whole area will be called 'Olympic City'.

quiz.q: 下列哪句正确表达“这个体育场能容纳两万人”？
options: The stadium can hold 20,000 people.
The stadium can held 20,000 people.
The stadium can be holding 20,000 people.
The stadium can be hold 20,000 people.

quiz.q: “工人们将在今年年底前把新路铺好”，正确的英文是？
options: Workers will complete the new roads by the end of this year.
Workers will be completing the new roads by the end of this year.
Workers will have completed the new roads by the end of this year.
Workers have completed the new roads by the end of this year.
quiz.note: by the end of + 将来时间点，用将来完成时。

quiz.q: “由于将有大批人来，政府将正在建造新饭店和一个大型体育场”，应选？
options: The government will build new hotels and an immense stadium.
The government is building new hotels and an immense stadium.
As a great many people will be visiting the country, the government will be building new hotels and an immense stadium.
The government will have built new hotels and an immense stadium.

quiz.q: “我们都盼望着奥运会的到来”，哪一句正确？
options: We are all looking forward for the Olympic Games.
We are all looking forward to the Olympic Games.
We are all looking forward to watch the Olympic Games.
We are all looking forward the Olympic Games.
quiz.note: look forward to 的 to 是介词。

quiz.q: “这些奇妙的现代化建筑是由库尔特·冈特设计的”，正确英文是？
options: The fantastic modern buildings have designed by Kurt Gunter.
The fantastic modern buildings have been designed by Kurt Gunter.
The fantastic modern buildings were designing by Kurt Gunter.
The fantastic modern buildings has been designed by Kurt Gunter.

quiz.q: “到明年年底，工人们将已经在新体育场上工作一年多了”，应选？
options: By the end of next year, the workers will work on the new stadium for over a year.
By the end of next year, the workers will have worked on the new stadium for over a year.
By the end of next year, the workers will have been working on the new stadium for over a year.
By the end of next year, the workers will be working on the new stadium for over a year.
